name: upt-chat-system
description: Sistema de agente interactivo con NLP para optimización de procesos de soporte técnico - Universidad Privada de Tacna

author.name: Piero Alexander Paja de la Cruz, Angel Gadiel Hernandez Cruz

scripts.install:all: npm run install:api-gateway && npm run install:db-seeder && npm run install:services
scripts.install:services: npm run install:chat-service && npm run install:nlp-service && npm run install:knowledge-base && npm run install:analytics && npm run install:notifications
scripts.install:chat-service: cd services/chat-service && npm install || echo 'Chat service not initialized yet'
scripts.install:nlp-service: cd services/nlp-service && npm install || echo 'NLP service not initialized yet'
scripts.install:knowledge-base: cd services/knowledge-base-service && npm install || echo 'Knowledge base service not initialized yet'
scripts.install:analytics: cd services/analytics-service && npm install || echo 'Analytics service not initialized yet'
scripts.install:notifications: cd services/notification-service && npm install || echo 'Notification service not initialized yet'
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run docker:build
